title: Large Astronomical Distance Product
description: You are building navigation software for deep space probes. Distances between star systems can be immense, exceeding standard integer limits. You are given two non-negative integers represented as strings, num1 and num2. Calculate and return the product of num1 and num2, also represented as a string.
constraints: num1 and num2 consist of digits only.
Both num1 and num2 do not contain any leading zero, except for the number 0 itself.
output_format: A string representing the product of the two numbers.
